msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Great! Since you’ve completed the theory and pool sessions, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option to finish your certification. Please bring your referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor.

The online price includes the 10% online discount; I can’t calculate a combined total here.

The refresher is a separate one-day activity, so doing it the day before the referral course would mean *three activity days*. The 2-day referral course also requires staying overnight on the islands on day one; accommodation isn’t included. The refresher is for certified divers who haven’t dived in more than two years. Since you have referrals and are completing your certification, please check with a team advisor whether a refresher is appropriate before booking.

The referred course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; the plan is the Open Water Referral Course, not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Yes—*Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* and *Hotel Cocoliso* are our dive bases on Isla Grande, so they’re the most convenient options for diving. Pick-up is direct from either hotel.

Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up arrangements can vary by hotel, and accommodation isn’t included in the dive plans—you book directly with the hotel.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Would you like help comparing the diving options once you’ve chosen your dates?

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?
reply:
Yes, we operate on Easter Sunday. We’re open every day except December 25 and January 1, with trips subject to weather conditions. April 5–6 sounds like a lovely plan for diving in the Rosario Islands.

The refresher is booked as the *Dive Mini Course*. Since you’ll be staying on the islands, the online price is *USD 134 per person* (the online price already includes the 10% discount). It includes pool practice and one ocean dive; lunch isn’t included. You can book and pay here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

For the two-day Open Water Referral Course, book separately here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/referral-already-on-the-island/26?language=en#rvrd-1. It requires your referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor and an overnight stay on the islands between course days.

A refresher and a certified diver can join the same outing.

The refresher is for certified divers who haven’t dived in more than two years. Is that the case for both of you?
